Inside, rolled tight, was a note in a child's careful hand: 'If you find this, tell my father the storm did not scare me. I am on the island of gulls, and I am brave.' The keeper read it twice, then looked out at the gray horizon where no island lay, only water and the slow swing of his own light returning to him. He folded the note into his coat, descended the stairs, and began, at last, to write a reply.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市在薄雾里呼吸。环卫工人的扫帚声划过空荡的街道，像潮水退去后的沙滩。二十四小时便利店的灯光如孤岛般亮着，玻璃门内飘出豆浆的热气。高架桥上偶尔驶过一辆货车，车灯划破夜色，又归于寂静。写字楼的轮廓在天空下沉默，只有零星几扇窗还亮着。早班的公交车缓缓驶出车站，报站声在冷空气中格外清晰。此刻的城市褪去喧嚣，露出柔软而疲惫的底色，像一个还未醒来的人，做着安静而绵长的梦。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something is defined in terms of itself, like a story inside a story.\n• Imagine Russian nesting dolls: to open the biggest one, you open it, find a smaller one inside, and repeat the very same step again and again.\n• Each step gets you closer to the tiniest doll, the one that doesn't open — that's the base case, the signal that tells the repeating to stop."}
